actual: backend.main imports quantevolver_evolution, which imports correlation_engine; correlation_engine executes torch.cuda.is_available plus a CUDA GEMM at module import. The idle backend therefore loads torch CUDA/cuDNN/cuBLAS and retains about 293.5 MiB dedicated GPU memory even when correlation status is idle and no QE task runs. Expected: backend import and idle/read-only correlation APIs consume no CUDA context; GPU is lazily initialized only inside an actual correlation compute execution, preserving CPU fallback and WSL dispatch behavior.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
